entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm calling about a VeloBand Pulse I bought a few weeks ago. I need to return it, but I'm pretty sure I'm just outside the return window and was hoping we could work something out.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you provide me with the order number?

Thank you. I see the order here for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on December 15th, so it's been about 21 days. Before we go further, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh no, there's nothing wrong with the device itself. It was a gift for my partner, but we had a family emergency right after it arrived. My partner had to be admitted to the hospital for an unexpected surgery.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope they are recovering well.

Thank you, they are. But with the recovery, they won't be able to use a fitness tracker for the foreseeable future. I feel bad because I missed the window dealing with all that. It felt like being on a sudden deployment where you lose track of everything else. I was hoping maybe I could get a partial credit or a discount code for a future purchase?
I completely understand how things like that can get pushed aside during an emergency. Let me just pull up our official return policy to see what options we have. One moment.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I've just checked our knowledge base, and it looks like you have nothing to worry about. Our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Oh, really? 90 days? I thought for electronics it was much shorter.

Yes, our system confirms it's a 90-day window for all VeloFit products. Since you're only on day 21, you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. There's no need for a partial credit; we can process a full return.
Wow, that's fantastic news! I really appreciate you checking that, Charlie. That's a huge relief.

Of course, I'm happy to help. I've just initiated the return process for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email on file right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. You'll see the refund within 3-5 business days after we receive it.
Perfect. Thank you so much for making that so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your partner a speedy recovery.
